Name: Demetrius on the Spectrum
Author: JaneElliot
Description:
[b][size=4]Autism spectrum Demetrius, written by someone actually on the autism spectrum.[/size]

[/b]While it's clear that Demetrius is supposed to be socially awkward, the man did manage to get married and father a child.  He had to have learned some social skills over the years.  This mod tweaks dialogue, festivals, and events to make Demetrius a little more realistic (and, incidentally, a little less of a jerk.)

[b]Highlights[/b]:
[list]
[*]Updated to include 1.6 content edits (see optional files for the 1.5.6 version)
[*]Edited most dialogue related to the relationship between the farmer and Maru
[*]Reworked the tomato and bed events
[*]Added acknowledgement of Sebastian's existence!
[/list]
[b]Config options[/b]:
[list]
[*]Toggle on/off dialogue edits for Demetrius and/or Sebastian
[*]Toggle on/off changes for the Maru event, the bed event, and the tomato event
[*]All changes are applied by default; to turn any option off, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM [/url]﻿in-game or run the game with the mod installed to generate a config file in the mod folder and make changes there
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]:
[list]
[*]Works with Canon Friendly Dialog Expansion and should work with More Personality for Demetrius
[*]Compatible with Stardew Kids Expanded, including some crossover content
[*]Will work with any mod that does not change Demetrius's dialogue (specifically: this mod was tested with Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, and East Scarp installed)
[*][b]Will[/b] [b]work [/b]with mods that change the three Demetrius events, [b]but only if you opt out[/b] from those events in the config options
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]:
[list]
[*]Requires Content Patcher version 1.30 or later
[*]Unzip the file and copy to your Mods folder
[/list]
Thank you to [b]AirynS [/b]for all of the coding assistance!  Please report any bugs/typos. [b] Enjoy![/b][list]
[/list]
